videos.video_script: Portugal just offered Ronaldo a way back. Hours after suspending him, the federation president said he expects Ronaldo back in November. Ronaldo walked out on his country, then apologised and asked to be punished. Now reports say his punishment could be cut in half. He has scored one hundred and forty-six goals for Portugal. Will Jorge Jesus pick him?
